notes.title: The Outbound Ghost IS BACK!!! + Sequel Announcement (Free For Steam Owners)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This is Conrad, the lead developer of [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i]. Over the past 2 years, this page has been silent because we were in a lawsuit with the game's former publisher ([url=https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/66627060/digerati-distribution-marketing-llc-v-conradical-sarl/]click here to see the details[/url]).

[b]Well, I'm happy to announce that [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i]'s lawsuit is now RESOLVED![/b]

My company Conradical Games (the original developers) are [b]self-publishing the game[/b], and it's now available again on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276810/The_Outbound_Ghost/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-outbound-ghost-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url], with the others versions coming out again soon! I've made a video that goes over what you can expect [b]now that [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i] is self-published by us[/b], but I'll also have a text version below.

[i](Also, keep on reading because we also just announced The Outbound Ghost's sequel and it's ENTIRELY FREE to owners of the original game!)[/i]

[previewyoutube=is9Qbyj3VpA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]In short, here's the rundown:[/b]

[h2]Key News[/h2]
[list]
[*] [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i] is back! It's available right now on Steam and Nintendo Switch
[*] The performance issues of the Nintendo Switch version have been fixed through a complete in-house re-port of the game by us, Conradical Games.
[*] All previous owners of [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i]'s Switch version will get the patch for free through an update on the 18th of October. The Steam update will be released in the coming weeks - we wanted to prioritise Switch because of the porting issues.
[*] The game will be re-launched on PlayStation at a later date, and will release on Xbox for the first time in 2025.
[*] The roadmap will be seen through, and some of the updates are already in the Switch version. Will come to Steam in the coming weeks.
[/list]

[h2][i]The Outbound Ghost[/i] Switch Update Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved framerate (stable 30fps).
[*] Improved loading times (~20 seconds per combat -> ~2 seconds per combat).
[*] German, Spanish, and French localisation.
[*] A rework of how the in-combat statuses are displayed.
[*] Completely remastered soundtrack.
[/list]

[h2][i]The Outbound Ghost: Reborn[/i], The Sequel![/h2]
As I mentioned above, not only are we updating [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i], but we're also announcing its sequel. [i]The Outbound Ghost: Reborn[/i]!

It's entirely free if you own [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i] on Steam, and it's a completely new adventure with a new story, updated combat, new areas, and new figments! Check out the Steam page below (and [b]wishlist it to be notified when it comes out[/b])!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884520/The_Outbound_Ghost_Reborn

[h3]Why a sequel though?[/h3]
Well, as we were implementing some of the roadmap additions, we felt that [b]we wanted to take the game even further[/b], but doing so would ruin save files, progression, and more. Because of this, we decided to make a sequel, and make it [b]entirely FREE for Steam owners[/b] if you own [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i] before [i]The Outbound Ghost: Reborn[/i] releases in 2025. This way, i[b]t's kind of like an update because Steam owners don't need to pay anything extra[/b], and we are also able to take the concept to the lengths we always wanted to.

You can find the reveal trailer below, and I can't wait to release the game next year!

[previewyoutube=ekYEHvk5sr4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Reviews[/h2]

Before the game entered the lawsuit, it sat around 75% - 80% ratings on Steam, and we felt that this would have easily increased over the additions of our roadmap features.

However, because of the lawsuit, [b]many people review bombed the game in our support[/b], which I really appreciate, but it is now [b]hurting our standing in Steam's algorithm[/b]. If you didn't enjoy the game, that's totally fine! But, if you did enjoy the game and want to support us, then [b]leaving a review would help us an immense amount[/b]. As well, if you're one of the players that review bombed the game in our support, I would really appreciate it [b]if you changed your review to be reflective of your thoughts on the game[/b], that would help us a lot!

[h2]Soul Stalker[/h2]

When the lawsuit started, I formed a new company called Radhood that [b]focused on self-publishing games[/b], and one of our games is actually set in the same universe as The Outbound Ghost, and[b] it's releasing on the 24th of October[/b]! 

It's called [i]Soul Stalker[/i], and it's a bullet heaven roguelike with paper graphics. [b]Think Vampire Survivors and Slay the Spire with Paper Mario-inspired visuals[/b]! If that sounds like your kind of thing, then getting the game in the link below would help us so much, and [b]it's discounted for owners of [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i] as well through a bundle[/b], so it's a win-win!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

[h2]Final Words[/h2]

Anyways, that's it for this update, and I'm SUPER excited to finally get back to being involved with [i]The Outbound Ghost[/i] publicly. I'll be keeping you all up to date as to when the first update will release exactly, but until then, make sure to watch the video I shared above to get the full context and learn about when each of the roadmap features will be added.

See you next time!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

A while ago I shared the roadmap and today I'm excited to reveal a shuffling of a few of the items + announce that the update to V1.1 is going to be coming out very soon! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225570/d51d06866d6f836da11534dda554ea0ea2b0ed7b.png[/img]

As you can see, we've also remastered the music (thanks [url=https://twitter.com/Kimmsoft_]Kimmo[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@GameroftheWinds]Greg[/url]!) and the soundtrack will be making its way to Steam, Spotify, YouTube, Bandcamp, etc. when V1.1 releases as well!

Anyways, that's it for today! Excited to release the updates soon!

notes.title: Vesion 1.0.17 (BALANCING, STORY BLOCKS, NEWS)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Here's another patch, and this week I'm also going to be showing the longer-term post-launch roadmap so keep an eye out for that!

Also, if you're liking the game and would like to support me, I would also [b]super appreciate it if you left a review[/b]! Anyways, here are the patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where some players reported being blocked from progressing the story in the Soggy Swamp when you meet Lori for the 3rd time.
[*] Fixed issue where some players reported being blocked from progressing the story after beating the first boss in the Soggy Swamp.
[*] Fixed issue where some players reported being blocked from progressing the story in Ravenside.
[*] Fixed issue where some players reported being blocked from progressing the story in other minor areas.

[*] Fixed Triple SP Steal bug that prevented the skill from giving the user SP.
[*] Fixed bug where the skills menu for Doubt wouldn't work properly if your player level was high enough.

[*] Adjusted EXP drops for the Mimic boss fight, but kept the EXP skill scaling the same.
[*] Fixed issue where some enemies didn't have the correct turn order sprite.
[*] Adjusted balancing for Head Start 1.

[*] Fixed typos in credits.
[/list]

A bit of a shorter this time around, but there's a good reason for that - we've started localizing the game! I can't confirm which languages are in the works right now, but there's a good bunch of them and I'm hoping to announce more soon!

Anyways, that's it for today's patch! If you appreciate the support that I'm giving the game (it's not going to end anytime soon), then[b] leave a review[/b] cause it helps me out immensely :)

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.content:

[/list]

That's it for today's patch! If you appreciate the support that I'm giving the game (it's not going to end anytime soon), then [b]leave a review[/b] cause it helps me out immensely :)

notes.title: Version 1.0.15 (ALL MINIMAP ICONS, DIFFICULTY ADJUSTMENTS, OOB FIXES).
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I know that yesterday I said that I wouldn't push an update today, but I got some time in the evening to compile a few of the updates that I had made previously and hadn't pushed, and combine them into this update (together with some small bug fixes)!

[*] Fixed out of bounds spot in the Outbound Trail.

If you've read yesterday's patch notes you'll now why todays patch is a bit smaller, but it fixes some key things that are important! 

As always, if you'd like to support the game [b]I would really appreciate it if you left a review :)[/b] Anyways, until next time!

notes.title: Version 1.0.14 (GET ALL RECIPES, ACCESSIBILITY, AND BUG FIXES)
notes.content:
It's day 3 of patching and we're making some good progress! I believe the rest of the reported game breaking bugs are now fixed as of this patch! On top of that, we're going to be sharing a roadmap of more reworks/post-launch content next week so keep an eye out for that 👀 

Also, [b]if you're liking the game and would like to support me, I would also super appreciate it if you left a review[/b]! Anyways, here are the patch notes:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to obtain chapter 1/2/3's non-chosen Aspect Recipes in chapter 4/5.

[*] Added the accessibility option to remove the sound distortion that you get from entering bushes.
[*] Added the accessibility option to remove the timing gauge on skills.

[*] Fixed issue where some users experienced "crackling" in menu sound effects.
[*] Fixed bug that made some users not get [spoiler]Levi as their partner in Ravenside[/spoiler] in chapter 4.

[*] Re-balanced the two harder difficulty settings to still have the same level of challenge, but with less tediousness. This was done through making the enemies' HP/Stun HP remain the same as the base difficulty, with everything else scaling to be more difficult.
[*] Balancing tweaks for the boss fight right before you get Trust.
[*] Fixed typos in some skills.

[*] Added dash tutorialization.
[*] Added first strike tutorialization.
[*] Added bushes tutorialization.
[/list]

Today's patch is a bit shorter in length, but each individual point makes up for it because the changes and improvements are massive! 

Would also like to say that there's not going to be a patch tomorrow unless it's super critical since it's my girlfriend and I's anniversary so I will be taking the day (mostly) off for the first time in a while! 

As always, if you'd like to support the game I would really appreciate it if you left a review :) Anyways, until next time!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

[*] Adjusted balancing of the ??? Apparition, the first chapter 2 boss.
[*] Fixed typo in several skills that SP steal.
[*] Adjusted the balancing of some overworld enemies.

[*] Fixed out of bounds spot in the Rocky Pass.
[*] Fixed out of bounds spot next to the big tree in the Snowy Pass.
[*] Fixed collision softlock in the Ravenside Cave.
[*] Fixed collision exploit that allowed you to skip over the first Soggy Swamp boss.
[*] Fixed out of bounds spot in the Outbound Trail.

[*] Fixed bug where Frank would sometimes not follow you after you unlocked the door with the 3 Keys of Delusions.
[*] Fixed typo in deaspecting dialog.
[/list]

Thanks for the support again everyone! And again, if you enjoyed the game leave a review cause it helps me out immensely :)

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: Version 1.0.12 Patch
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It's day 2 and I still have even more fixes and QOL changes coming your way 😎. Check out what they are:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where if you lost to the first chapter 2 boss, you could get the Annoyance figment multiple times.
[*] Fixed bug where if you left the cutscene trigger of the cutscene before the first chapter 2 boss, you could play the cutscene again without Michael being there.
[*] Fixed bug where sometimes the screen would shake and audio would be muffled in some spots like Strand Beach and the Southern Outskirts.

[*] Fixed bug where sometimes you could not edit the default character name in the name input screen.
[*] Added a "Mirror" to the Southern Outskirts that allows you to change the player's name after it has been first set.

[*] Fixed out of bounds spot in the Toterwald.
[*] Fixed out of bounds spot in the Graveyard.
[*] Fixed out of bounds spot in the Outbound Trail.
[*] Fixed out of bounds spot in the Soggy Swamp.
[*] Fixed collision lock in Central Outbound where you could get stuck inside of Ethel's stall.
[*] Removed invisible collision in the Snowy Cave.

[*] Removed floating tree in Ravenside Path.
[*] Adjusted LOD error in the Outbound Trail that resulted in sometimes showing a floating tree.

[*] Fixed typos in chapter 2 cutscenes.
[*] Fixed NPC in Ravenside that would freeze the conversation under certain conditions.

[*] Adjusted balancing for the Sadism 1 and Sadism 2 aspects.
[*] The Grave Spirit 1 aspect description said that it replenished SP, but replenished HP instead. This has been fixed and now matches the description.
[*] Adjusted the balancing of the last chapter 3 boss.
[*] Adjusted Mimicry AI for your figments, so that they make for more interesting fights when enemies with Mimicry turn into your own characters.
[*] Adjusted balancing for the first chapter 1 boss.
[*] Callousness' Guard skill said that it applied Major Defense to itself, but it applied it to the target. This has now been fixed.
[*] Fixed bug where lifesteal aspects would heal characters adjacent to a character using an area of effect skill.
[*] Fixed bug where the Ligrou figment caused issues with story progression.

[*] Fixed graphical issue where the Corvid Apparition in the Deep Toterwald had a white line coming out of its wing.
[*] Fixed lockpick gate that said it required lockpicks, when in reality it required Roald's Key. Functionally this is the same as before, the description just didn't match.
[*] Adjusted chest drops in the torch puzzle in the Soggy Swamp that rewarded you with a duplicate aspect recipe set instead of 2 aspect gems.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for reporting the stuff you find, it's only because of you that I can fix it all!

notes.title: THE BAD BUG IS FIXED!!!
notes.content:
I'm not kidding, this is probably the (2nd) worst bug I've had to deal with in my entire time programming (granted it's only been like 5 years but it was still pretty bad :^| ). To get this fix, download the latest update! You'll know you have it if the main menu version is 1.0.11.

[h1]I'm happy to confirm that we have fixed the following:[/h1]
- Some users experienced a "Chapter 1 lock" where you couldn't progress the story after beating Ernest's boss. [b]This is now FIXED![/b]

- Some users experienced issues with the game crashing on startup when the Unity logo shows. [b]This is now FIXED![/b]

- Some users experienced issues with bosses where if you lost to them and went to another battle, wining that battle counted as beating the boss. [b]This is now FIXED![/b]

- Some users experienced issues with the randomization settings where some bosses that shouldn't progress the story, did so. [b]This is now FIXED![/b]

As you can see, lot's of fixing went on in these past few hours :))). If there are any other bugs that you all have found, feel free to put them here in the comments, tell me [url=https://discord.gg/enfBJjdUmJ]on the Discord server[/url], or tell us [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1276810/discussions/0/6296618058106558715/]on the Steam community pinned post![/url]

It's been a blast to see everyone playing and enjoying the game, hearing the feedback, and the general reception! Thank you so much to everyone for supporting the game :)

Also, if you're reading this and don't have the game, then go to the Steam page to get it because it's out now!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225570/7ec1fa3532c7820ad775c59ce6119442010f104a.png[/img]

Anyways, that's it for now!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: Demo Patch Version 1.03
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's the third day that the demo's available, and I'm glad to announce that I've barely gotten any new bug reports today, so we're nearing the singularity ;) Anyways, today's patch has quite a few balancing changes, and some bug fixes as well! Very importantly as well, I managed to get the game's file size to 4GB down from 10GB! You won't believe how this happened...

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- Callousness now gets Minor Limit Break at level 9 instead of at level 11.
- Callousness now gets Minor HP Share at level 11 instead of level 13.
- Callousness now gets Fair Defense at level 13 instead of level 17.
- Callousness now gets Guard at level 17 instead of level 20.
- Callousness now gets Fair Limit Break at level 21 instead of at level 25.
- Comradery now gets Minor Power at level 4 instead of at level 5.
- Comradery now gets Lesser Revive at level 5 instead of at level 6.
- Comradery now gets SP Defense Levarage at level 6.
- Comradery now gets Minor SP share at level 7 instead of at level 9.
- Comradery now gets Minor Replenish at level 8 instead of at level 12.
- Comradery now gets SP Steal at level 11 instead of at level 17.
- Comradery now gets Field Heal at level 14 instead of at level 22.
- Comradery now gets Fair Heal at level 17 instead of at level 27.
- Comradery now gets Fair Revive at level 20 instead of at level 31.
- Regret now gets Poison Poke at level 6.
- Regret now gets Magic Strikes at level 5 instead of at level 6.
- Minor SP Share now shares 7 SP instead of 5 SP.
- Changed point where you get Comradery from the third conversation with Mary and Michael to the second.
- Fixed bug where sometimes the textbox in Michael's first line in the fourth cutscene would be out of view of the camera.
- Adjusted Minor Limit Break such that it gives you an AP benefit even if you use it with 1 AP, whereas before it was only useful with 2 AP.
- Adjusted Major Limit Break such that it gives you an AP benefit even if you use it with 1 AP, whereas before it was only useful with 2 AP.
- Fixed out of bounds situations in Eris' Forest.
- Fixed out of bounds situations in Strand Beach.
- Added extra dig spots next to shovels in Strand Beach to make it clearer how the shovel is used.
- Got the game's filesize down to 4GB from 10GB (it was literally a checkbox to enable compression, I could've sworn that this was already on but I guess not 🙃).
- Added demo version counter in the title screen.

Hope you enjoy your newly squished game file!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: New Demo Update, Spinoff Announcement, Friday's Devlog, And Being 223% Funded
notes.content:
Hi everyone! If you're[url=https://discord.gg/yQBQADnXP2] in the game's Discord server[/url] you might know that I've recently been working on making controls clearer! The main feedback I've received from players of the demo is that the button prompts being standardized regardless of your input device is very confusing, and I agree. That solution was always meant to be temporary, but I finally got to implementing something more reliable! The screenshot below shows the new HUD that is in the game!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/418/505/f12a70ff6968a70420542b9536bb40df_original.PNG?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1628093939&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=1a0e94899a003d6261c72057b8a3595b[/img]

As you can see on the top left, the HUD includes button prompts for both dashing and your currently selected item. Something I noticed when watching people play the demo is that they knew how to select an item with the item wheel, but they didn't know how to use it or expected the item to be used immediately upon selection. This new addition should make it clearer! Let me know what you guys think of the change!

Speaking of button prompts, at the beginning of the demo you can now select which input type you would like to use.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/418/176/0a2a5900521c312d8c97b4771c54f5da_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1628092155&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=b32643f511b68156a0992e48d9eaa90a[/img]

Once you select it, all prompts in the game will match your choice! Below you can see a before/after screenshot comparing how the prompts were before and how they are now.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/418/225/c472ff14150d5f9a446a92b6bf4d5a91_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1628092398&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=c56809c7e2e1c16df84c10ab0b297d0d[/img]

You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276810/The_Outbound_Ghost/]play the demo right now on Steam[/url] so if these new quality of life updates interest you, make sure to give it a try!


Those of you who have seen one of my previous updates know that I am working on a little spinoff of The Outbound Ghost, and below's a little screenshot showing how it's progressed since then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225570/2e0cfe4c019ae756aabf916b464c036d58447cd8.png[/img]

If you're not aware, the artstyle is based off of [url=https://twitter.com/ConradicalGames/status/1292954976424165378]the original prototype version of The Outbound Ghost[/url] before it went in a more Paper Mario-like direction! What genre do you think this game pertains to? I'd love to hear your thoughts in the comments! If you want to learn more about it, [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3SUzBUNbS95AaLyW6lD8Pg]this Fridays YouTube devlog[/url] will cover most of your answers and more! Make sure to catch it! The spinoff will also be free for all Kickstarter backers who pledged for any tier containing a copy of the game!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/418/365/592473379bb475b337a4b9c3a0dcea3d_original.PNG?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1628093103&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=f94e50ce0b7736e89dd492825598ee01[/img]

This cool pixel style won't just be limited to this spinoff though, as I'll also announce in this [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3SUzBUNbS95AaLyW6lD8Pg]Fridays devlog[/url] a special option in the main game regarding this style that only [url=https://www.kicktraq.com/projects/conradicalgames/the-outbound-ghost/]Kickstarter[/url] backers will have! 

Lastly, I'd like to thank you all again! We're 223% funded, which is absolutely insane! I can't wait to continue working on this awesome game, and I hope that you will all like it when it comes out next year!
